newsitem.title: USA: Norand trims losses as Q1 revenues rise.
newsitem.headline: Norand trims losses as Q1 revenues rise.

text.p: Norand Corp said Thursday a combination of higher sales and lower bank debt helped trim losses in the first quarter to $233,000, versus a loss of $4.8 million one year ago.
"The company has continued to experience significant growth in revenues and gross margin percentages," said N. Robert Hamer, Norand's chairman and chief executive officer.
The company reported revenues of $55.4 million in the first quarter that ended November 30, compared with $49.8 million one year ago.
Its stock closed off 3/16 Thursday at 17-7/16.
